description: This file defines a SwiftUI View component named HomeToolbar, which creates a custom toolbar for an iOS application. It includes multiple subviews and buttons for controlling and displaying status, chat, talk, and settings functionalities. The code manages visual styles, accessibility, and animations related to the toolbar's appearance and interactions.

classes.name: HomeToolbar
classes.description: Main toolbar view component with buttons and layout for iOS app.

classes.name: HomeToolbarStatusButton
classes.description: A subview representing the status indicator button within the toolbar.

classes.name: HomeToolbarActionButton
classes.description: A reusable button component used for different toolbar actions such as chat, talk, and settings.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the SwiftUI view layout for the HomeToolbar component.

methods.name: updatePulse
methods.description: Updates the pulsing animation state of the connection status indicator based on the gateway state and environment conditions.
